maria: VerdantCare POC scheduling: they want sustained 500 qps, occasional 2x-3x bursts up to 1500 for ~5m, p95 target <150ms on 512-token outputs. BYOK requirement + TLS. Can we do Wed 10-11am PT? ajay: Quick details needed: exact model variant (ft vs large), avg seq len, quantized or fp16? those change p95 a lot. maria: They prefer our recommended chat model (redwood-chat-recommend), avg ~280 tokens, cap 512. Prefer quantized if latency penalty <~15%. tara: Proposed run plan: smoke at 50 qps -> ramp to 500 over 8m -> hold 30m -> three burst windows (5m each) to 1500 with 15m cool-downs. Use canary routing to Dedicated pool and auto-fallback to smaller hosted model if SLOs break. I can run the smoke. ajay: HW suggestion: Dedicated A100x1-per-core should meet p95 with q8 quant, fp16 safer for tails. Note BYOK adds ~2-3% latency on initial key access; KV cache reduces repeated KMS hits. kevin: Customer asks for burst pricing delta to budget. ajay: Rough delta: bursts using ephemeral capacity -> +35-45% token cost during burst windows depending on cache hit rates and batching efficiency. I'll send a calc after smoke. riley: KMS checklist: need their key ARN and a policy granting our service principal access; confirm whether key is regional (we can only access keys in same cloud region for perf); if network restrictions, we need an allowlist for our egress IPs or VPC peering. maria: Also they require multi-AZ failover for 99.9% availability. tara: Multi-AZ doable but expect +10-20ms median due to routing; recommend running both single-AZ and multi-AZ modes in POC and capture numbers. loadbot: perf-test job queued: verdantcare-wed-10am (id: ft-499999). results will be auto-posted here. ajay: Load generator (vegeta) plan for smoke test: ```# vegeta target template echo "POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"redwood-chat-recommend","input":"<sample prompt>"}" > targets.txt vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=500 -duration=30m | vegeta report -type=json > smoke_report.json``` kevin: Need a one-pager rough price for CSM to show customer, ballpark is ok. ajay: I'll post a cost sketch after smoke; fallback policy: if p95 >250ms for 2m, auto-switch to fallback smaller model. riley: Ops runbook snippet: - slot: Wed 10-11am PT - rollback: disable burst + route traffic to fallback model - contacts: #eng-oncall -> escalate to ajay -> riley - gather traces, kv-cache hit rates, kernel-selection logs for postmortem maria: Tara please confirm client's KMS contact + ARN; Kevin please confirm budget threshold that would trigger committing burst capacity. tara: I'll get KMS contact and ARN today, will paste here :thumbsup: kevin: I'll confirm budget by EOD :eyes: maria: Good — if all aligned I'll schedule the run and attach pre-run checklist here. thanks all.
